facts.fact: The Sudan government portal says the first foreign-trade export contract was completed fully electronically on the Baladna platform, which links trade, customs, standards, ports, border crossings, tax, Zakat and veterinary and health clearances as a single window for foreign trade.

facts.fact: The Sudan government portal says Baladna, a government data and transactions exchange platform, carried the first fully electronic export contract between the Central Bank of Sudan, the Ministry of Trade and Industry, customs, standards, ports, border crossings, tax and Zakat systems.
